_why: What the golden harness itself may stop pinning (bin/goldens/golden_manifest.py): <cases> names a dropped case or cell, or a cell newly declared not applicable, as <set>.<list>:<item> (e.g. host_matrix.cells:medchron/busy); <normaliser> names a normaliser added, changed or removed (e.g. host_matrix_normal._ULID). Each entry is exact, reviewed with the PR, and cleared after it merges. Step 5c (2026-11-24): the relay census names act_reply.code_reply and act_reply.model_words_only as not recorded (a hold step 5c makes is the recorded _held), cases.py adds the act_filed, status_contradicted and checklist_code_words cases, and drive.py adds the act knob that notes a turn's tool calls before the draft (a tree without shared.turn_facts ignores it).
